desc:
Get flung off a giant slingshot in a plane made of junk, fly as far as you can, and evolve it all the way to a Jetliner! ✈️

🎯 LAUNCH off the slingshot. Tap in the green zone for a PERFECT LAUNCH!
🛠️ UPGRADE your Launcher, Plane and Income. Every 5 Plane levels bolts on a new part!
🏁 FLY through the finish line to EVOLVE:
Pizza-Box Plane ➜ Rubber-Band Racer ➜ Crop Duster ➜ Pontoon Seaplane ➜ Stunt Biplane ➜ Jetliner

🌎 6 worlds: Backyard, Giant Classroom, Farm Valley, Island Lagoon, Red Canyon and Mega City
🚩 Beat your RECORD flag and race your friends across the same sky

🎁 CODES: TAKEOFF · EVOLVE · BACKYARD
⏰ ERA 2: SKY AGE is on the way, with new planes and worlds every week!

👍 Like + ⭐ favorite for a free boost
👥 Join the Voxcept group for +10% coins forever!
